title: Grateful Dead Live at Richfield Coliseum on 1991-09-04
lineage: MAC > Sony WM-D6 > Edirol R09 HR > 24/48 wav > Adobe Audition > Wavelab 6 (with iZotope Ozone 4) > iZotope RX Advanced > 16/44.1 wav > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; taped and transferred by John Bleich
source: Source: Audience recording > Nakamichi 300s (with cp1 caps) > Sony WM-D6 > MAC;

ai_review.summary: Excellent early‑sampling soundboard recording with a standout Fire performance and overall fabulous concert
ai_review.review: The reviewer hails this tape for its superb fidelity, calling the early‑sampling sound “outstanding” and praising the entire concert as fabulous. The highlight noted is an exceptional rendition of “Fire,” and the set even produced what they consider the greatest “Scarlet” later in the tour.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review lauds both performance and sound quality, indicating a top‑tier show with excellent recording; limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer emphasizes great sound and outstanding general quality throughout the tape, suggesting a clean, well‑balanced capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall described as a fabulous concert with strong momentum; no negative comments on pacing or transitions.
